text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (May 8, 2025) for 661 Huron Street.

The Property Standards Committee – Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (May 8, 2025) for 661 Huron Street, Folder Number 25 156386 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to August 29, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
